differences.what: massing: three storeys over a low basement, the north part of the front recessed behind the entrance porch, the rest standing forward as one block carrying two bows, flat behind a cornice
differences.how: T-1878: the 1911 sheet's plan on K01 with a K08 forward block and two bows on its face; this camera puts every corner within 10 px

differences.what: the bows' lights: two a storey on each bow, a blank pier of wall at its middle (x 923-1027 px on the north bow), where the record had three
differences.how: T-1879: at_deg -33 and 33 on the north bow and -31 and 31 on the south (887/1050 px against the plate's 891/1050 on the north bow, 1280 px on the south), so each light's shutters stay on its bow

differences.what: the forward block's third floor: a light over each side of each bow (x 867, 1247, 1363 px; the fourth behind the tree) and a round-headed light with a fan between the bows (x 1120-1180 px), where the record had three square lights
differences.how: T-1879: four K06 sash at s 1.8, 5.2, 9.35 and 12.15 m along the face and K06's round fanlight sash at 7.2 m

differences.what: each bow roofed at the third floor as a balcony behind a stone balustrade (x 805-970 px on the north bow, x 1207-1407 px on the south)
differences.how: T-1879: the kit's stone balcony round each bow's eaves, 0.75 m high

differences.what: the forward block's parapet: a balustrade over its cornice the length of its front (x 740-1450 px)
differences.how: T-1879: the kit's stone balcony round the projection's flat top, 0.8 m high

differences.what: the recessed front's parapet: solid for about 1.5 m from its north-west corner, then balusters under a rail to the forward block (x 503-705 px)
differences.how: T-1879: flat_balustrade, the blocking course stopped at a 0.2 m plinth from s 1.5 to 3.35 m with square balusters under a 0.15 m rail

differences.what: open louvred shutters beside every light of the front: the recessed front's two upper lights and every light of the forward block and the bows but the round-headed one
differences.how: T-1879: window_shutters on the recessed front's storeys 1-2 and shutters on every bay light, 0.42-0.45 m leaves, slats 0.1-0.12 m

differences.what: iron at the ground floor's lights: a balconette under the north bow's north light (x 857-920 px) and a run of iron nearly continuous across the next three (x 1007-1340 px)
differences.how: T-1879: a guard on a stone slab under each ground-floor bay light, 0.85 m high and 0.3 m out, the forward block's centre one reaching 0.9 m past its light so the three meet the bows within about 0.2 m

differences.what: the tall plain stack rising about 3.5 m over the parapet at the forward block's north return (x 710-790 px, its top at y 210)
differences.how: T-1879: the stack moved to v 4.6 m and its top to 16.9 m over grade (top at y 205 px through this camera)

differences.what: the north flank: one column of openings about 4 m back from the front corner — a window at the third floor, a small oval light at the second, a narrow slot at the principal floor — and blank wall otherwise, where the record had two columns of windows
differences.how: T-1879: side_bays read off this picture (K01's south wall is this house's north wall in its frame)

differences.what: the oval light on the north flank is built square-headed at its size (0.45 x 0.7 m): K01 cuts no oval
differences.how: the outlines differ only at the corners, under 0.1 m, on a flank the camera sees at a grazing angle

differences.what: the small carved tablets over the upper lights (x 575-650, y 640-660 px and their like): a cornice hood stands for them on the recessed front and the bay lights take K06's plain head
differences.how: relief inside a band under 0.3 m deep over each head; the element's place and size are there, its carving is not

differences.what: the balusters are turned in the plate and built square
differences.how: each under 0.1 m across; the rhythm, height and rail match

differences.what: the forward block's parapet starts at its north-west corner with a solid pedestal about 1.5 m long (x 745-825 px), which is built pierced
differences.how: same height, line and stone, the difference is the piercing of 1.5 m of a 14 m balustrade; the kit's projection balcony sets only corner posts (0.3 m), and broad posts were tried and stood as cubes over the rail, so they were not kept

differences.what: the main cornice's modillions or dentils (x 420-700 px) under the crown
differences.how: relief under 0.15 m within the cornice's built depth

differences.what: the porch's columns stand about 10 px nearer each other in the plate than in the render
differences.how: about 0.15 m at the porch, inside the fit's 12.7 px worst residual

differences.what: the walls' colour, the shutters' colour and the stone's tone
differences.how: a monochrome plate; the pale buff paint and the shutters' deep green are reconstructed (docs/LIBERTIES.md L-k01-1721-dexter-1878 and L-k01-1721-dress-1879)

differences.what: the forward block's south end, its third floor between the bows and the south bow's south light
differences.how: behind the street trees from x 1000 px on
